title: Dead load source
description: Woodcore-Datei/loads/dead/<id>.json -- one build-up of layers whose permanent load Woodcore computes (calc/domains/dead_load_source.py, docs/domain/loads.md §3.3ter, issue #35). Read beside the EL+AL-* sheets of a load workbook, under the same domain dead-load; an id both carry is refused.

schema_version.description: -- pinned. 1.1 (issue #42): 1.0 with `links`, written only where a field follows a variable. 1.2 (issue #110): a layer names a material by its id, library catalogue -- written only where one does. 2.0 (issue #111, what Woodcore writes): a layer's pose, its material by its id, link to the line below in place of beside, fill, role; 1.x read through calc/domains/dead_load_migrate.py, in memory.

id.description: The file name without .json, and the instance the report names: letters, digits and _ . + -.

group.description: Optional: the folder of Woodcore's list, "" for the root.

chosen.description: The permanent load designed with, kN/m², rounded up from the sum of the layers; null takes the tenth above or equal to the sum (2.0; the sum itself before).

kind.description: gk: Eigenlast (poids propre); ak: Auflast (surcharge) -- the engineer's choice for each layer.

pose.description: 2.0: continuous γ·t, spaced γ·t·b/e (width, spacing), surface γ (a weight per m², the thickness drawn only), typed the load written (load) -- calc/domains/dead_load_layers.py.

library.description: 1.x only. Where the weight is read: SIA 261 Anhang A (Tabelle 28 or 29), Woodcore's materials library, the project's materials.json 1.0 -- or direct, a load typed in kN/m² (`load`); since 1.2 (issue #110) catalogue: one material by its id, shipped (sia265:, sia265-1:, sia261:, ext:) or the engineer's own (u-…), of which the project keeps a copy.

material.description: 1.x: the line of the library -- SIA 261's id, the workbook's material name (with its `ebene`), the project's id; for `catalogue` the material's id; for `direct`, the words the table prints. 2.0: the material's id (sia265:, sia265-1:, sia261:, ext:, lignum:, u-…, project:<id> for a 1.0 project's own weight), null for a load typed.

label.description: 2.0: the words of a load typed, or a name typed that no material carries yet.

ebene.description: 1.x only. The workbook's Ebene, which keys its library with the name.

thickness.description: In mm, above 0: what a weight per volume is multiplied by, and what the drawing stacks.

width.description: In mm: the width of battens, rafters or joists set at `spacing`; 2.0: on a line that does not fill (fill false) the width it covers on 1 m; null otherwise.

spacing.description: In mm: the spacing of those members, centre to centre; null for a continuous layer.

beside.description: 1.x only. true: the layer shares the band of the layer above it, drawn in its gaps (the insulation between the rafters). 2.0 says it the other way: link on the layer above.

link.description: 2.0: true where the layer shares its level with the line below (two lines at most, one spaced and one that fills, D-07).

fill.description: 2.0: on a level with a spaced line, true (the default) where this line fills the gap the pieces leave, 1000·(1 − b/e) mm on 1 m; false, the width written, 1000 where none is.

role.description: 2.0: what the layer is for, optional -- one of dead_load_layers.ROLES.

load.description: 1.x: for `direct`, the load typed, kN/m², above 0. 2.0: the load of a load typed, or the load that replaces the calculation of a layer of any other pose (ARCH-006), kN/m², above 0; null for none.

links.description: The fields of this entry that follow a variable of the export, by their key (thickness, width, spacing, load): the number the field holds is the last value known, which a variable that can no longer be read leaves in place with a warning (D-06). Absent where none follows one; only at schema_version 1.1.

.*.description: A variable of the export this field follows (calc/domains/links.py, spec 2026-10-11-variables-liees-champs-et-textes D-17): the pair a call names its calculation by and its key -- a domain of the «Formule» tab carries origin "formulas" and its id as instance --, with an optional factor and offset (factor × variable + offset).

links.description: The fields of this entry that follow a variable of the export, by their key (chosen): the number the field holds is the last value known, which a variable that can no longer be read leaves in place with a warning (D-06). Absent where none follows one; only at schema_version 1.1.

.*.description: A variable of the export this field follows (calc/domains/links.py, spec 2026-10-11-variables-liees-champs-et-textes D-17): the pair a call names its calculation by and its key -- a domain of the «Formule» tab carries origin "formulas" and its id as instance --, with an optional factor and offset (factor × variable + offset).
